summary: ICICI Bank filed a Form 6-K under Indian Listing Regulations disclosing that the Reserve Bank of India approved the re-appointment of Mr. Ajay Kumar Gupta as Executive Director for two years starting November 27, 2026. This is a routine regulatory approval for a previously announced board decision, not an abrupt departure or new appointment. Shareholder approval is pending at the AGM scheduled August 21, 2026. The filing is procedural and informational, with no special-situation characteristics such as strategic review or M&A activity.
